simple.meaning: בִּקְעָה (biqʻâh) appears 20 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 11:2. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּקְעָה (H1237) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows בִּקְעָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: בִּקְעָה (biqʻâh) / H1237 is tracked through Genesis 11:2, Deuteronomy 8:7, Deuteronomy 11:11, Deuteronomy 34:3. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: As they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
and the south,

Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Israel, and they struck them, and chased them to great Sidon, and to Misrephoth Maim, and to the valley of Mizpah eastward. They struck them until they left them no one remaining.
from Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, even to Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. He took all their kings, struck them, and put them to death.

These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.
The mountains rose,
Every valley shall be exalted,
I will open rivers on the bare heights,
As the livestock that go down into the valley,
Yahweh’s hand was there on me; and he said to me, “Arise, go out into the plain, and I will talk with you there.”
Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the river Chebar. Then I fell on my face.
Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.
Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me out in Yahweh’s Spirit, and set me down in the middle of the valley; and it was full of bones.
He caused me to pass by them all around: and behold, there were very many in the open valley; and behold, they were very dry.
I will break the bar of Damascus,
In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.

definitions.full: H1237. biqah בִּקְעָה noun feminine valley (cleft), plain — absolute ׳ב Gen 11:2 8 t.; construct בִּקְעַת Deut 34:3 7 t.; plural בְּקָעוֺת Isa 41:18 ; Psa 104:8 ; בְּקָעֹת Deut 11:11 ; — 1 valley (opposed to הַר mountain) Deut 8:7 ; 11:11 ; compare Isa 41:18 ; also 63:14 תֵרֵד בַּבִּקְעָח כַּבְּהֵמָה ; in creation-poem Psa 104:8 בְקָעוֺת יֵרְדוּ הָרִים יַעֲלוּ . 2 plain (sometimes valley-plain, broad valley) Gen 11:2 ; also Ezek 3:22-23 , 8:4 ; 37:1-2 ,( הַבּ ׳עַלמְּֿבֵי ) as level, opposed to סִים הָֽרְכָּ Isa 40:4 (|| מִישׁוֺר ); elsewhere construct mostly with proper name Deut 34:3 ׳ב יְרֵחוֺ (appositive הַכִּכָּר ), ׳ב מִצְפֶה Josh 11:8 , ׳ב הַלְּבָנוֺן 11:17 ; 12:7 , ׳ב מִגִדּוֺ 2Chr 35:22 compare Zech 12:11 , ׳ב אוֺנוֺ Neh 6:2 ; אָֿוֶן׳ב Amos 1:5 plain of idolatry = Baalbek (Damascus, according to Wetzst in De Jes 3, 702 ; ᵐ5 πέδιον Ὤη ).
